verdict.rationale: Plausible offers only fixed, built-in background jobs: scheduled email reports, reports sent to a Slack channel, and traffic spike/drop alerts that run on their own once configured. Users cannot build their own automations or agent-driven workflows. The Stats API and Events API could be scripted, but only with external tooling. Missing for 10: user-definable automation/workflow rules, triggers beyond traffic spikes, webhooks or action hooks, any AI/agent-driven autonomous tasks, and independent hands-on corroboration.
